question: “818 年中返场大促”期间gmv与活动前相同天数对比
output:
{"type": "sql", "sql": "WITH promo AS (
  SELECT
    start_date,
    end_date,
    CAST(julianday(end_date) - julianday(start_date) + 1 AS INTEGER) AS days
  FROM dim_promotion
  WHERE promo_name = '818 年中返场大促'
),
summary AS (
  SELECT
    p.start_date AS promo_start_date,
    p.end_date AS promo_end_date,
    p.days AS promo_days,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.dt BETWEEN p.start_date AND p.end_date THEN o.pay_amount ELSE 0 END) AS promo_gmv,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.dt BETWEEN date(p.start_date, '-' || p.days || ' days') AND date(p.start_date, '-1 day') THEN o.pay_amount ELSE 0 END) AS pre_gmv
  FROM promo p
  CROSS JOIN fact_orders o
  WHERE o.dt BETWEEN date(p.start_date, '-' || p.days || ' days') AND p.end_date
  GROUP BY p.start_date, p.end_date, p.days
)
SELECT
  promo_start_date,
  promo_end_date,
  promo_days,
  promo_gmv,
  pre_gmv,
  promo_gmv - pre_gmv AS gmv_diff,
  1.0 * promo_gmv / NULLIF(pre_gmv, 0) AS promo_vs_pre_ratio
FROM summary;"}

question: “开学季”期间成交额与活动前相同天数对比

{"type": "sql", "sql": "WITH p AS (
  SELECT MIN(start_date) AS start_date, MAX(end_date) AS end_date
  FROM dim_promotion
  WHERE promo_name LIKE '%开学季%'
),
pp AS (
  SELECT start_date,
         end_date,
         CAST(julianday(end_date) - julianday(start_date) + 1 AS INTEGER) AS days_cnt
  FROM p
),
w AS (
  SELECT start_date,
         end_date,
         days_cnt,
         date(start_date, '-' || days_cnt || ' days') AS pre_start,
         date(start_date, '-1 day') AS pre_end
  FROM pp
)
SELECT w.start_date AS promo_start,
       w.end_date AS promo_end,
       w.days_cnt,
       w.pre_start,
       w.pre_end,
       (SELECT SUM(o.pay_amount) FROM fact_orders o
         WHERE o.dt BETWEEN w.start_date AND w.end_date) AS gmv_promo,
       (SELECT COUNT(o.order_id) FROM fact_orders o
         WHERE o.dt BETWEEN w.start_date AND w.end_date) AS orders_promo,
       (SELECT SUM(o.pay_amount) FROM fact_orders o
         WHERE o.dt BETWEEN w.pre_start AND w.pre_end) AS gmv_pre,
       (SELECT COUNT(o.order_id) FROM fact_orders o
         WHERE o.dt BETWEEN w.pre_start AND w.pre_end) AS orders_pre,
       (SELECT SUM(o.pay_amount) FROM fact_orders o
         WHERE o.dt BETWEEN w.start_date AND w.end_date) * 1.0
         / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(o.pay_amount) FROM fact_orders o
                    WHERE o.dt BETWEEN w.pre_start AND w.pre_end), 0) - 1 AS gmv_growth_rate,
       (SELECT COUNT(o.order_id) FROM fact_orders o
         WHERE o.dt BETWEEN w.start_date AND w.end_date) * 1.0

question: “中秋礼盒节”期间GMV与活动前相同天数对比

{"type": "sql", "sql": "WITH promo AS (
  SELECT MIN(start_date) AS start_dt,
         MAX(end_date)   AS end_dt
  FROM dim_promotion
  WHERE promo_name = '中秋礼盒节'
),
periods AS (
  SELECT start_dt,
         end_dt,
         CAST(julianday(end_dt) - julianday(start_dt) + 1 AS INTEGER) AS days,
         date(start_dt, '-' || CAST(julianday(end_dt) - julianday(start_dt) + 1 AS INTEGER) || ' days') AS prior_start,
         date(start_dt, '-1 day') AS prior_end
  FROM promo
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT days FROM periods) AS days,
    (SELECT start_dt FROM periods) AS promo_start,
    (SELECT end_dt FROM periods) AS promo_end,
    (SELECT prior_start FROM periods) AS prior_start,
    (SELECT prior_end FROM periods) AS prior_end,
    (SELECT SUM(o.pay_amount) FROM fact_orders o, periods p WHERE o.dt BETWEEN p.start_dt AND p.end_dt) AS promo_gmv,
    (SELECT COUNT(o.order_id) FROM fact_orders o, periods p WHERE o.dt BETWEEN p.start_dt AND p.end_dt) AS promo_orders,
    (SELECT SUM(o.pay_amount) FROM fact_orders o, periods p WHERE o.dt BETWEEN p.prior_start AND p.prior_end) AS prior_gmv,
    (SELECT COUNT(o.order_id) FROM fact_orders o, periods p WHERE o.dt BETWEEN p.prior_start AND p.prior_end) AS prior_orders
)
SELECT
  days,
  promo_start,
  promo_end,
  prior_start,
  prior_end,
  promo_gmv,
  prior_gmv,
  promo_gmv - prior_gmv AS gmv_diff,
  (promo_gmv - prior_gmv) / prior_gmv AS gmv_growth_rate,
  promo_orders,
  prior_orders,
  promo_gmv / promo_orders AS promo_aov,
  prior_gmv / prior_orders AS prior_aov
